messages:
Nina: Heads up 0s: I'm proposing a small wording update across onboarding: change 'Get started' CTA to 'Finish setup' once a user has completed at least one step. Keeps progress explicit. Thoughts?
Maya: I like clarity. But 'Finish setup' might feel like a blocking modal. Maybe 'Continue setup' when mid-flow and 'Finish setup' only on final step.
Kevin: Analytics: users who see 'Get started' vs 'Continue setup' have negligible diff. But conversion to sample import spikes when CTA copy mentions 'sample' explicitly.
Sam: Accessibility: when CTA label changes dynamically, ensure SR announces the change and button keeps focus. Use aria-live="polite".
Olivia: Mock: https://figma.com/file/ghi789/onboard-copy-states shows states for Get started / Continue setup / Finish setup.
Nina: Also flagging a11y: color contrast on the banner CTA falls to 3.8:1 on some themes. Need to fix before shipping.
aria-bot: Scan result: CTA contrast ratio 3.8:1 on dark theme - recommend #ffffff on #0b5fff or increase weight. Also ensure focus ring 3px and visible in high-contrast mode.
Sam: Microcopy tweak: 'Add sample project' vs 'Import demo' table: non-dev participants preferred 'Add sample project'.
Maya: We'll standardize on 'Add sample project'. Also add hover tooltip: 'Installs a demo app into your workspace' for first-time users.
Kevin: I'll add an experiment to vary CTA presence and copy. EXP-623.
Olivia: I'll iterate Figma and include contrast fixes.
Nina: Action items: Olivia update mocks; Sam to add aria acceptance; Kevin create EXP-623; Maya to update content matrix.
Maya: Thanks!
